findings.text: follow-on: the unwired_plan_message change adds plan-section-depends-on and plan-after, but no test pins the message's wire-form names (tests/test_unwired_plan_message_names_its_population.py:71 asserts only the population wording), so a later edit could drop a form with the suite still green.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 97c79d155c71292ea7f20556d04a9babfddeae6b; the single commit d92832404 changes reckon/doccheck.py, reckon/roadmap.py, reckon/_schema.py, the test file and the fragment, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the node's done_when (its prompt L127) names the shared extractor, the prose-word no-wire tests, the two message forms, a masked base/head roadmap+audit diff, a no-added-failure neighbourhood suite and the logged negative control; the manifest records each and I reproduced the raw base/head diffs and the empty added-failure set.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to read a gate's plan refs through one declared-form reader shared by the audit and the roadmap; reckon/doccheck.py:1173 defines gate_declared_refs and both reckon/doccheck.py:1217 and reckon/roadmap.py:271 call it.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports 43 passed on the focused gate, neighbourhood suites 7 failed/3587 passed at head against 8 failed/3583 passed at base, a red negative control (3 failed, EXIT=1) and the two IDENTICAL-after-masking diffs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/doccheck.py, reckon/roadmap.py, reckon/_schema.py, reckon/mcp_discovery.py, tests/test_section_relations_count_as_wiring.py and the evidence fragment; every path in the diff is inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_section_relations_count_as_wiring.py:279 and :304 redden under the declared mutation per negative-control.log and :164 pins the positive y#s2 wire, but the reckon/_schema.py:332 message change carries no assertion.
justifications.evidence: the manifest records neigh-head.log "7 failed, 3587 passed" against neigh-base.log "8 failed, 3583 passed" and negative-control.log "3 failed ... EXIT=1", and I reproduced the raw base/head roadmap and audit diffs as differing only in cache tmp-filename tokens.
justifications.fit: the new gate_declared_refs and _GATE_TEXT_FIELDS at reckon/doccheck.py:1170 follow the module's regex-constant and field-tuple idiom and carry no plan or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/doccheck.py:1173 gate_declared_refs is the single declared-form reader and both reckon/doccheck.py:1217 and reckon/roadmap.py:271 delegate to it, which is the goal.
justifications.reuse: the only other gate-ref reader, reckon/roadmap.py:229 _gate_section_refs, now calls the shared extractor instead of parsing gating_plan itself, so no capability is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff against 97c79d155c71292ea7f20556d04a9babfddeae6b lies inside the six declared write paths.
